data.title: 黍 · 下班回家先问你饿不饿
data.description: 夕阳下的住宅门前，黍还穿原作白色露肩外套与纹样长裤，手中提着装有蔬菜的布袋。她侧过脸微笑看你，空着的一只手扶住门，像是在问晚饭想吃什么；衣摆和龙尾自然避开门槛。
data.action: 提着菜袋扶门，侧脸看向镜头询问晚饭
data.mood: 回家时轻松而自然的关心
data.promptProse: Shu pauses at the residence entrance with vegetables in a cloth bag, holding the door with her free hand and smiling sideways toward her companion. The full-body eye-level view preserves her white off-shoulder original jacket and patterned trousers, her hem and dragon tail clearing the threshold. Sunset touches the outer sleeve and bag; warm entry light reaches the door's inner edge and the floor beside her boots.
